sentences.en: Layla is still working to regain her ability to speak.
sentences.zh: 莱拉仍在努力恢复说话的能力。

sentences.en: Sami thought he had regained control of his complicated life.
sentences.zh: 萨米以为他已经重新掌控了自己复杂的生活。

sentences.en: You may regain the use of your legs one day.
sentences.zh: 你有一天可能会再次使用你的双腿。
